Manchu woman's robe of heavy, blue woven cotton. Half length sleeves folded over with yellow lining and trim. Upright collar and round neck, with knot and loop fastening at one side; and a short panel underneath with dye in floral shape in corner. The garment widens from the waist and has large side slits; the front and back are decorated with an embroidered border of flowers, birds and fish using pink, orange, blue and cream thread; and an appliqué ribbon of floral design in green, blue, purple and pink above in geometric shape. This is also present around the neck and upper fastening, with floral pale yellow embroidering on the sleeves.
